Core Standard 1 (Req 1): Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the hazards you are most likely to encounter while wood carving, and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, or lessen these hazards.
Core Standard 2 (Req 1): (b) Show that you know first aid for injuries that could occur while wood carving, including minor cuts and scratches and splinters.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 1): Review the official Wood Carving requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Wood Carving Hazards, PPE & First Aid Response.
Execute & Document: Perform the demonstrate task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Wood Carving Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
